summary: STRATTEC filed an 8-K under Item 1.02 to report the termination of a material definitive agreement. Its majority-owned JV, ADAC-STRATTEC, entered into a new credit agreement with BMO Bank, replacing the prior one from 2012. STRATTEC was a guarantor on the prior agreement and its guaranty, liens, and obligations were released; it is not a party to the new credit agreement. The filing involves a routine credit facility refinancing at the JV level with no change in corporate control, no strategic event, and no impact on shareholders. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisors were mentioned. This is a standard operational update, not a special situation.
